resource_label: Annual household resources after modeled taxes, excluding health benefits; includes SNAP, WIC and other noncash benefits valued by the model. Housing/utility expenses affect benefit rules but are not subtracted from this resource measure.
assumptions: All members are US citizens with citizen SSN cards and live together in Harris County, Texas throughout2025. Memberships remain constant throughout the year.

One unmarried male adult is the tax-unit/household head. The parent scenario adds one4-year-old dependent daughter. Each person has a separate marital unit. Filing status is a stated scenario premise, not a new legal-eligibility finding.
The adult earns a fixed$30 hourly wage over52weeks. Annual earnings0–60000 and usual weekly hours0–38.461538 vary together at61 paired points. The child has no earnings or work hours.

Annual rent is12000; electricity1800, telephone600 and water360 are paid separately. Electricity provides heat and cooling. Other utility bills and paid childcare are0. Formula-owned childcare expense outputs are not supplied.

Bank assets are1000 for the adult and0 for the child; stocks/bonds/other assets are0. The input-only SPM-unit asset measure is1000. Any low-earnings housing-budget shortfall may be debt-financed; no additional income is imputed.
Listed input-only nonwage income facts are0. Remaining primitive monetary inputs use model zero defaults; no calculated tax bases or benefit awards are supplied.

Neither person has employer health insurance or a disqualifying offer. They do not buy ACA coverage; Medicaid/CHIP take-up istrue if eligible, with enrollment derived. Health benefits are excluded from resources under the unchanged baseline.
SNAP/TANF and EITC take-up istrue if eligible. No housing-assistance allocation or Head Start placement is assumed; those take-up inputs arefalse. No eligibility or final award is overridden.
The child has a hypothetical independently stated WIC nutritional-risk assessment and claims WIC if eligible. The adult is not pregnant, disabled, blind or a college student.

The adult control uses the model steady-state ABAWD approximation: initial3 countable months within36 months are not tracked, and noncompliance can cause immediate exclusion. This does not establish universal year-long entitlement or absence of SNAP cliffs. The parent child-age exemption is calculated.
Requested input/calculation year is2025; native structural selection defaults2024. These curves do not certify every2025 legal branch or a2017comparison.
law_qualification: UNQUALIFIED; exploratory inputs for source validation; no population or historical comparison

questions: The released0.33 parameter differs from the handbook1/3 fraction. Determine whether any operative rounding authority changes this before labeling a legal boundary.

The run does not supply historical TANF enrollment; is_tanf_enrolled derives from reported receipt, defaultFalse. The applicant rule has a prior4-month condition; a repeated-month static applicant calculation does not reproduce a longitudinal receipt path.

Grant amounts320Jan–Sep/331Oct–Dec are frozen model dates; current native C-110 and its revision/context are preserved, but the complete2025 grant schedule has not been independently authenticated in this unit.
Budgetary needs650 and25% recognizable share are model source cells; official A-1340/C-110 native texts are captured for a later clause/table review, not blanket2025 qualification.

Official A-1341 (effective2021-07-01) and A-1425.3 require applicants to pass recognizable PartA andPartB; the native applicant countable-income/payment branch does not implement both staged disregards or the four-month90% window. Exact lawful payment treatment requires a separate source contract.
Official A-1342 (effective2024-10-01) rounds adjusted gross income down to whole dollars before calculating the grant; native regular_tanf subtracts fractional countable income directly.

Current C-110 is Revision26-4, effective2026-10-01. Its size2 caretaker table shows budget650/recognizable163. It cannot authenticate2025 grant values or justify a2025 needs-rounding assertion. The4365 number is explicitly conditional on the MODEL162.50 limit, not a sourced final legal cutoff.
selected_policy_validation.scope: Model source discontinuity candidate only; independent eligibility/disregard/rounding/payment chronology remains unresolved.

TANF_enrollment_assumption: Unspecified enrollment derives from reported TANF receipt; no reported receipt is supplied, so the model treats the scenario as a non-enrolled applicant. This is not a source-authenticated year-long eligibility history.
scope: Two genuinely calculated hypothetical household curves. All six native component identities/finite/axis/SPM guards passed. No figure qualification, population estimate, historical-law comparison or precise legal cliff magnitude follows.
